title: Groups
intro: Play the daily with friends, family or colleagues: see who's done today, compare times once you've finished, and watch the bridges between you grow.

list.title: Your groups
list.text: Every group you're in, and how many have crossed today.
list.none: No groups yet. Create one and send the link to your friends.

create.title: Create a group
create.text: Give it a name, then send the invite link to whoever should join. No account needed.
create.name: Group name
create.invite_hint: Got an invite link? Just open it to join.

ready.title: Your group is ready!
ready.text: Send this link to your friends: whoever opens it can join with one click.

invite.title: Invite link
invite.copied: Invite link copied to the clipboard.
invite.share_text: Join my group “{{ name }}” on Hashi and let's compare our daily bridges!
invite.rotate_confirm: Make a new invite link? The old one stops working.
invite.rotated: New invite link made, the old one doesn't work any more.

join.title: Join “{{ name }}”
join.text: Members comparing their daily bridges here: {{ count }}
join.full: This group is full, it has 50 members already.
join.guest_hint: No account needed: you join as a guest and can claim a username any time.
join.invalid_text: It may be mistyped, or the group made a new one. Ask a member for a fresh link.

page.title: Group
page.not_found: This group doesn't exist, or you're not a member of it.
page.not_found_hint: Ask a member for the invite link to join.

archipelago.label: The group's archipelago, an island per member. Done today: {{ done }} of {{ total }}
archipelago.bridge: {{ a }} & {{ b }} · days both solved: {{ days }}
archipelago.legend: A bridge for every pair of neighbours who solved the same daily in the last four weeks, a double bridge after seven such days. A pennant flies over everyone who's done today.

today.title: Today
today.your_turn: {{ done }} of {{ total }} done – your turn!
today.all_waiting: Nobody has crossed yet – be the first!
today.spoiler: Times show up once you've finished today's daily yourself.

members.title: Members
members.remove_confirm: Remove {{ name }} from the group? They can join again with the invite link, unless you make a new one.
members.removed: {{ name }} is no longer in the group.
members.leave_confirm: Leave “{{ name }}”? You can join again with the invite link.
